text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... It seems my summer training<n>has borne
fruit.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But I must wear the proverbial helm<n>firmly; I can't
let this victory go to my<n>head.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Take me to the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Arrange it so that I may face her at<n>the illustrious
Nakayama Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That's been my intention since I<n>started on
this path.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Determination. I cannot turn my back<n>on that
promise.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My reputation as the Beast's<n>Successor has been
cemented, but<n>now it's time I lay claim to the true
name!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: And... Oh?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: No, but I thought I heard...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Ah, El...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...? I wonder what's wrong.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Normally, El is more... in my face<n>when she's
vexed.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I think back on how tenacious El<n>Condor Pasa
appeared during<n>summer camp.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: It's gotta be me.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I have to be the one her eyes arefollowing on the track—the one sheglares at with such fire!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
For Grass Wonder, everything is just<n>a stepping
stone on the path to<n>Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
From El Condor Pasa's point of view,<n>that must
be...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Um...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now you're acting strange too. Is<n>something the
matter?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
This is an extremely important time<n>for Grass
Wonder.

After all the work she's been putting<n>in, telling her
now might throw her off<n>pace.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: So, I keep my mouth shut.
